info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Submission Amendment-spec
info.description: The Submission Amendment Management API facilitates the process of amending existing trade submissions within the banking market operations. This API enables users to submit requests for modifications to prior submissions based on evolving trade conditions or compliance requirements. Users such as financial analysts and reporting teams leverage this API to ensure that trade records are accurate and up-to-date. It supports operations on specific submission IDs, allowing for precise management of trade reporting obligations.

post.summary: Create an amendment for a trade submission.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an amendment for a specific trade submission identified by its unique ID. Amendments can include changes to trade terms, conditions, or related metadata. Ensure all required fields are accurately provided to process the amendment successfully.
